Department of Mathematics
Welcome to the Department of Mathematics at USC Dornsife. We offer a wide range of research and education opportunities in pure and applied mathematics. We also form a lively and engaged community of scholars. Please explore our website, from student resources to faculty personal pages, from math clubs to research seminars, to learn more about us and about our offerings and activities.

Conference in honor of Professor Susan Friedlander
The conference on
Recent Advances in Mathematical Fluid Dynamics
in honor of Professor Susan Friedlander’s 80-th birthday will be held at USC from October 8 to 10, 2026.
Former USC Professor Yu Deng receives the Fields Medal
Yu Deng was awarded the Fields medal for his work on his resolution of a 125-year-old problem to rigorously ground physics in mathematics by describing the motions of gases. Yu Deng was an Assistant Professor at USC from 2018 until his promotion to Full Professor in 2024.
Sheel Ganatra speaks at the International Congress of Mathematicians
Sheel Ganatra delivered a lecture in the Topology section of the International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM) in Philadelphia in July 2026. His talk “Structural Approaches to Fukaya Categories and Mirror Symmetry” opens new directions at the most prestigious mathematics conference.
Aravind Asok awarded a DARPA grant as a co-PI
Aravind Asok, together with Jesse Wolfson (UC Irvine) and Alexa McLain (UC Irvine), receive a $2.6 million DARPA grant to drive AI math breakthroughs.
Unlike evaluations that test AI on closed problem sets with known answers, this project will examine AI’s impact in active research environments. The team will develop a framework to evaluate how these tools affect productivity on unsolved questions relevant to current mathematical research. Researchers will convene groups of about 20 mathematicians for four-day workshops twice a year over three years, with small teams tackling open problems in a setting monitored by the project team.
Evgeni Dimitrov receives the IMI prize
Evgeni Dimitrov receives the 2026 prize of the Institute for Mathematics and Informatics at the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences. The prize is given once every 3 years to one mathematician under the age of 40 of Bulgarian descent for outstanding achievements in mathematics. Congratulations, Evgeni!
Kyler Siegel promoted to Associate Professor
We are pleased to announce that Kyler Siegel has been promoted to Associate Professor (with tenure) in the Department of Mathematics. Congratulations Kyler!
2026 Whiteman Lectures
Ravi Vakil, Stanford University, will deliver the 2026 Whiteman Lectures. The first lecture will be held on Tuesday, April 28, 2026, 4-5:30pm. See the flyer for more information.
Robert Guralnick and Juhi Jang have been awarded Simons Fellowship
Robert Guralnick and Juhi Jang have been awarded Simons Fellowships in 2026. The fellowship supports an extended research leave of up to a full academic year, enabling recipients to focus exclusively on research. Congratulations to both!
Congratulations Xiaohui Chen
We are pleased to announce that Xiaohui Chen has been promoted to Full Professor in the Department of Mathematics. Congratulations!
USC Dornsife Launches a New Master’s in Mathematical Data Science
USC Dornsife has introduced a Master of Science in Mathematical Data Science that focuses on the mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence. The program emphasizes probability, optimization, and linear algebra alongside real-world data applications. It prepares students for careers in AI-driven fields or advanced research.
RTG in Geometry and Representation Theory awarded to USC team
The NSF has awarded a new Research Training Group (RTG) grant to a PI team in the math department. This grant will support new research and training activities in representation theory, low dimensional topology, symplectic geometry and motivic homotopy theory. Congratulations to the PI’s Aravind Asok, Sami Assaf, Julian Chaidez, Sheel Ganatra, and Aaron Lauda!
